title: Total Cost of Homeownership
description: Port of ApexLogics Apex #153 (AL-167) Total Cost of Homeownership into the AINumbers chaingraph shape. Given purchase price, loan terms, recurring costs, growth assumptions and a hold period, the node amortizes the mortgage month by month, charges mortgage insurance while the post-payment loan-to-value is strictly above a drop threshold, grows property tax, insurance, maintenance, HOA and utilities year by year, applies the interest-plus-SALT deduction offset at the caller's marginal rate, compounds the opportunity cost of cash at close, and returns gross and net cost of ownership over the hold, break-even monthly rent and a cost-composition breakdown in basis points. Only a hold under one year is refused (REFUSED_BAD_HOLD_YEARS); a refusal carries the same payload keys as a success. Declared divergences: the SALT cap fallback stays at the Apex $10,000 for vector fidelity while the official 2026 figure is $40,400 (26 USC 164(b)(7)); the 78 percent automatic MI-termination leg of the Homeowners Protection Act is not modeled (80 percent borrower cancellation only); the deduction benefit omits the itemize-versus-standard threshold and the acquisition-indebtedness limit. Port provenance: Apex page https://apexlogics.org/tools/153-total-cost-of-homeownership/ fetched 2026-10-13 (sha256 D6015F52F3099C412879F6D23DE00A616F48E3CBB9970DD2C657961AEA307AA3), tasking APEXPORT-153 (GRADES PASS-PENDING-XV 2026-10-18, Builder-verifies-at-land 35/35 vectors), landed by APEX-PORT-153-LAND-1 on 2026-10-20.

price.description: Purchase price (Apex input price, default 450000). Clamped to [0, 50000000].

downPct.description: Down payment, percent of price (Apex downPct, default 20). Clamped to [0,100]; below 20 the LTV starts above 80 so MI accrues.

annualRate.description: Mortgage interest rate, percent APR (Apex rate, default 6.5). Negative becomes 0 (interest-free branch).

termYears.description: Loan term in years (Apex termYears, default 30). Under 1 becomes 30; capped at 40; months capped at 480.

closingPct.description: Closing costs, percent of price (Apex closingPct, default 2.5). Negative becomes 0.

miRatePct.description: Mortgage insurance rate, percent of the original loan per year while post-payment LTV is strictly above the drop threshold (Apex miRate).

propertyTaxRate.description: Property tax, percent of purchase value per year (Apex propertyTaxRate, default 1.1). Negative becomes 0.

insuranceAnnual.description: Annual homeowners insurance in USD (Apex insuranceAnnual, default 1800). Grown yearly by inflationPct.

hoaMonthly.description: Monthly HOA dues in USD (Apex hoaMonthly, default 0). Annualized then grown yearly by inflationPct.

maintenancePct.description: Annual maintenance, percent of price (Apex maintenancePct, default 1.0). This input drives the math.

extraUtilities.description: Annual utilities beyond what you pay renting, USD (Apex extraUtilities, default 1200). Grown yearly by inflationPct.

appreciationPct.description: Home appreciation, percent per year (Apex appreciation, default 3.0). May be negative; negativeAppreciation flags it.

taxGrowthPct.description: Property-tax growth, percent per year (Apex taxGrowth, default 2.0).

inflationPct.description: Insurance/maintenance/HOA/utilities inflation, percent per year (Apex inflationRate, default 3.0).

holdYears.description: Years you plan to stay (Apex holdYears, default 7). Under 1 is refused: REFUSED_BAD_HOLD_YEARS.

sellingPct.description: Selling costs at exit, percent of sale price (Apex sellingPct, default 6.0). Clamped to [0,20].

oppRatePct.description: Opportunity-cost rate on cash invested, percent per year, annual compounding (Apex oppRate, default 5.0).

marginalRatePct.description: Marginal income-tax rate for the interest+SALT benefit (Apex marginalRate, default 0). Enter 0 on the standard deduction.

cMiDropLTVPct.description: LTV percent at which MI drops (Apex cMiDropLTV, default 80; HPA cancellation date). Non-finite falls back to 80; MI charges strictly above it.

cSaltCap.description: SALT deduction cap per year, USD (Apex cSaltCap, default 10000). Falsy input falls back to 10000; official 2026 figure is 40400 (26 USC 164(b)(7)).

mcp_tool_definition.name: total_cost_of_homeownership
mcp_tool_definition.description: Total cost of homeownership ported from ApexLogics Apex #153 (AL-167): month-by-month mortgage amortization, MI while post-payment LTV is strictly above a drop threshold, year-grown property tax, insurance, maintenance, HOA and utilities, an interest-plus-SALT deduction offset, opportunity cost on cash at close, and gross/net cost of ownership with break-even monthly rent and a bps cost composition. Holds under one year are refused. Full provenance in the manifest description.

grossCost.description: Gross cost of ownership over the hold (excludes principal, which becomes equity).

netCost.description: Gross cost minus equity gained from price growth; exceeds gross when appreciation is negative (not clamped).

breakEvenMonthlyRent.description: Net monthly cost; renting for less and investing the gap wins.

loanBalanceAtExit.description: Raw amortized balance (NOT money-rounded, matching Apex); exactly 0 when holdYears*12 exceeds the loan term.

shareBps.description: Cost composition in basis points over grossCost (deductibleBenefit reported negative).

refusal.description: Null on success; REFUSED_BAD_HOLD_YEARS when holdYears is under 1 (Apex error text carried in message).

output_schema.description: output_payload shape. A refusal and a success carry the SAME keys: on refusal every field except inputs/refusal/message is null and compliance_flags carries ART770_INPUT_REFUSED.

input_schema_provenance: Each property is exactly the policy_parameters member the kernel reads; there is no other input surface. All 20 properties are required and mirror the Apex page inputs and editable-constants panel; cMaintenanceRuleOfThumb is excluded (Apex calculate() never reads it, Apex ~L484). Bounds mirror the clamps the compute actually enforces.
